title: Staged dark-sector decay

baseline.label: Flat GR · radiation + matter
baseline.scope: Retain conventional radiation and matter outside a chosen dark cascade. In the primary Agrawal-like branch quintessence replaces Λ; ΛCDM is a comparison. The distinct Naidoo-like branch retains constant Λ and imposes a daughter EOS instead of deriving quintessence exchange.
baseline.parameters_reason: No candidate input set is registered. Source illustrative or fitted values are not adopted as prospect parameters.

cosmology.gravity: Conventional GR Friedmann equation in reduced-Planck units; no modified-gravity sector proposed.
cosmology.geometry: Flat homogeneous expansion is inferred from Eq.(5), H^2=sum(rho)/3 without a curvature term; the source does not give an explicit metric.
components: Retained radiation and baryons plus other pressureless dark matter in rho_O.
A selected dark-matter fraction is a charged parent A that decays to neutral daughter B.
Primary branch: canonical quintessence chi, with a double-exponential potential and daughter-only mass dependence.
modifications: Prescribed late dark-Higgs symmetry breaking activates A→2B; B then exchanges energy with chi.
Separate phenomenological Naidoo comparison: assigned w_B(a) and constant Λ; do not simultaneously retain that Λ and the primary quintessence branch.
Massive-vector SIDM sector and radial mediator are a separate proposed follow-up, not an established replacement for the cosmological dark-matter abundance.
cosmology.background: Retained A/B/chi source terms cancel in the displayed homogeneous system. Higgs/radial energy, recoil and pressure distributions are omitted; a closed trigger/transition energy budget is unresolved.
cosmology.perturbations: Source explicitly restricts the asserted Naidoo correspondence to background expansion. Growth, CMB/ISW, fifth-force and microscopic transition closure are not supplied by H(z) overlap.
observables: Minimal test: retained-sector energy-source cancellation and common-normalization H(z).
Audit which observables/likelihoods actually match; no external fit evidence transfers automatically.
Separate SIDM follow-up: scattering only after units, velocity and identical-particle conventions are settled.

scope: Audit conservation and branch identity before any controlled H(z) comparison.
Lost scope: Higgs dynamics, full transition energy budget, perturbations, likelihood refitting, fifth-force viability and halo formation.
The three associated ideas include a mechanism, an inference limit and a separate SIDM candidate; they do not establish one qualified combined cosmology.
unknowns: Parent/daughter masses, recoil, pressure and production.
Perturbations, radiative stability, vector abundance/stability and statistical lineage.
Source SIDM units/relative velocity and current consumer capability.

combination_compatibility.basis: Unchecked beyond the explicitly sourced branch; shared topic membership does not authorize mixing mechanisms.

Sec.III.B and IV.A, PDF pp.4-5, Eqs.(13)-(16): separate constant-Λ/daughter-EOS branch and explicit lack of perturbation correspondence; Sec.IV.B/Appendix for separate SIDM.
